title: Embodied fly, stage 4a: the chip-to-animal drug design with movement as the readout: when does movement fail, and does the chip or the output-tract electrode flag the drug first? (SIMULATED)
roadmap: report/ROADMAP_EMBODIED_FLY.md, stage 4 (drugs in the loop): 'the registered chip-to-animal design rerun with movement as the readout; does the chip still flag drugs after movement fails; does the output-tract electrode still lead'
parents: preregistration/fly_chip_to_animal.json (conditions, doses, chip readout, onset rule)
seen_before_registration: every result of the parents: the chip first flags each family at a higher dose than neural behaviour fails (C2 failed in all five families: chip doses 0.6, 1.0, 0.8, 0.4, 0.4 against behaviour doses 0.2, 0.25, 0.4, 0.2, 0.1 for GABA-A block, GABA-A potentiation, GluCl block, ACh block, excitability block); the tract array flags in time in 3 families against 2 for the planar 64 (T3 passed); at the motor level the chip was never earlier (fly_motor_readout, tie-break)
vehicle movements (stages 2b, 1f): sugar extends the proboscis (time-averaged 0.3054 mm), sugar with bitter 0.0488 mm; antennal input brings the claw to 0.5369 mm of the antenna (rest 1.528)
no simulation under a drug condition with a body has been run

design.conditions: exactly the parent's: vehicle; GABA-A block (gaba_scale 0.8, 0.6, 0.4, 0.2, 0.0); GABA-A potentiation (1.25, 1.5, 2.0); GluCl block (glut_scale 0.8-0.0); ACh block (ach_scale 0.8, 0.6, 0.4, 0.2); excitability block (threshold_scale 1.1, 1.2, 1.4, 1.6); dose as in the parent (|level - 1|)
design.where_the_drug_acts: in every simulated network of the trial: the FlyWire brain and, for the reach, the male nerve cord

movements.proboscis_sugar: stage 2b: FlyWire 783 brain under the published right-side sugar drive (150 Hz, no background), proboscis motor pools to the flybody proboscis (r_full 20 Hz); readout the time-averaged extension (mm)
movements.proboscis_sugar_bitter: the same with the published bitter drive added
movements.reach_depth: stage 1f: FlyWire brain under JO-CE drive, descending spikes replayed into the male nerve cord (matched by cell type and side), the FlyMimic leg (r_full 20 Hz); readout the depth of reach, 1.528 mm minus the minimum claw-antenna distance

design.movement_disruption: per condition, the mean over the three movements of |log2((x + 0.01) / (x_vehicle + 0.01))| on median values (mm; 0.01 mm keeps the ratio finite near zero); impaired when >= 0.5 (the parent's line); 0.05 mm reported as sensitivity
design.chip: the parent's recorded planar-array |delta log2 mfr| per condition, detection at >= 0.5 (the parent's rule)
design.tract: the tract stage's recorded tract_64 and planar_64 deltas per condition, detection at its registered threshold (0.156)

N0_the_movements_are_there.statement: Precondition: under vehicle the movements of stages 2b and 1f appear
N0_the_movements_are_there.test: vehicle median proboscis_sugar >= 0.1 mm and median reach_depth >= 0.3 mm; if not, N1-N5 are uninterpretable

N1_disinhibition_releases_the_bitter_gat.statement: As the parent's B1, at the movement level
N1_disinhibition_releases_the_bitter_gat.test: Spearman(block fraction, median proboscis_sugar_bitter) over vehicle + 5 GABA-A block levels >= 0.8

N2_excitation_block_stops_movement.statement: As the parent's B2, at the movement level
N2_excitation_block_stops_movement.test: Spearman(block fraction, median readout) <= -0.8 for proboscis_sugar and for reach_depth over vehicle + 4 ACh block levels

N3_the_chip_flags_before_movement_fails.statement: The parent's C2 with movement as the readout
N3_the_chip_flags_before_movement_fails.test: for every family with any movement impairment, the chip's first detection dose <= the first movement-impairment dose

N4_the_output_tract_still_leads.statement: The tract stage's T3 with movement onset
N4_the_output_tract_still_leads.test: the tract_64 array flags at or before movement onset in more families than the planar_64 array

N5_movement_fails_no_earlier_than_neural.statement: The body is downstream of the neural readouts and saturates, so it buffers small neural changes
N5_movement_fails_no_earlier_than_neural.test: in every family with both onsets, the first movement-impairment dose >= the parent's first behaviour-impairment dose

not_claimed_even_if_all_pass: anything about any compound in any animal or person: the knobs are transmitter-class scalings in a simulated fly; a pass means that in this simulated fly the chip's and the tract electrode's timing relative to failing movement is as stated
reporting: Every prediction with its value and pass/fail or uninterpretable, whichever way it falls; per condition the three movements and the disruption index; per family the onset doses (movement, neural behaviour, chip, tract, planar 64); the 0.05 mm sensitivity.
